# Ending scene fixture

Mara placed the bakery key beside Jo's coffee. Between them, the old recipe book lay
open to the page their mother had stained with cherry syrup.

"You keep it," Mara said.

Jo closed the book but left the key where it was. Outside, the new owner raised the
metal shutter. Morning light crossed the table and stopped at Mara's wrist.

She stood. Jo touched the book, then pushed the key toward the empty chair after Mara
had gone.

They both understood that grief had changed them and that, although the past could
never be repaired, each would now find a separate way forward.
